task: Read-only feasibility design for the A0 factual baseline, A0R exact replay guard, and A1 zero-CLIP influence gate.
verdict_scope: Ready to prepare and independently review a CPU-FP32 direct-sampler replay implementation. Scientific execution remains blocked until a real S40 run and readback, a frozen natural-failure case, and source-bound replay artifacts exist.

arm_contract.A0: The pre-registered factual S40 batch and its saved mean-CLIP output after full S40 readback.
arm_contract.A0R: One direct sampler replay using byte-identical saved sampler inputs and sampler-entry RNG, followed by the same VAE decode.
arm_contract.A1: The same direct replay with only conditional c.crossattn replaced by zeros_like; the entire uc dictionary and every other input remain byte-identical to A0.

key_source_findings: S40 can preserve the actual pre-mutation noise, c and uc branches, c2w, K, input mask, scale, cache provenance, samples, samples_z, and sampler-entry and return CPU RNG states.
The sampler performs torch.randn_like draws at every Euler step, so restoring seed or initial noise alone is insufficient; the saved sampler-entry Torch CPU RNG state is required.
Direct replay must bypass do_sample because do_sample creates a new initial noise tensor, and it must bypass get_context_info and get_cond to avoid retrieval and condition reconstruction.
The released get_cond builds uc.crossattn as zeros_like(c.crossattn); therefore A1 specifies only the conditional c.crossattn delta and reuses uc byte-for-byte.
A0R uses zero-tolerance byte identity for sampler inputs, samples_z, decoded tensors, sampler-return RNG, and unchanged live cache/map state on the frozen CPU-FP32 stack.
required_source_preparation: Immutable S40-batch replay-bundle freezer and type-preserving RNG deserializer.
Direct sampler runner with fresh per-arm tensor clones and forbidden-call guards.
Fresh-worker external supervisor and append-only partial-failure archive.
Exact replay verifier that blocks A1 on any A0-to-A0R mismatch.
Independent source review followed by an approval bound to the actual replay-bundle core.

MPS cannot serve as an exact replay backend for the CPU factual A0 and is explicitly outside this protocol.
